matched_queries: Discover UK employment guidance for Seafarers Charter. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
This notice should be read with the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018 and replaces MGN 583 (F) Amendment 1.

Amendment 2 updates references only.

Notice to

fishing vessel owners

operators and managers

employers of fishermen

skippers

officers and fishermen on fishing vessels.

Annex’s A and B attached separately provide model formats for a fishermen’s work agreement.
